test_dataframe_neg_operator: test the unary negation operator on pandas DataFrame columns with numeric and object dtypes
test_dataframe_pos_operator: test the unary positive operator on pandas DataFrame columns with numeric and object dtypes
test_dataframe_invert_operator: test the bitwise invert operator on pandas DataFrame columns with boolean and integer dtypes
test_dataframe_abs_operator: test the abs function and numpy abs ufunc on pandas DataFrames with nullable integer and float dtypes
test_dataframe_unary_raises: test that unary negation and positive operators raise TypeError for string and datetime dtypes
